friction_section.title: The Friction Point
friction_section.subtitle: Micro-finance institutions face high operational costs and difficulty assessing creditworthiness without traditional collateral.

cards.title: High Manual Overhead
cards.description: Paper-heavy loan applications and field visits drive up administrative costs per dollar lent.

cards.title: Inaccurate Risk Profile
cards.description: Lack of formal credit history makes it difficult to distinguish reliable borrowers.

cards.title: Collection Latency
cards.description: Fragmented repayment tracking leading to delayed follow-ups and higher default rates.

architecture_section.title: Lean Capital, Smart Distribution.
architecture_section.description: We build a digital financial layer that uses alternative data points to automate the entire lending lifecycle.
